BC_description: The option 'forceKillAfterTimeout' has been renamed to 'forceKillAfterDelay' and its location has changed. Previously, 'forceKillAfterTimeout' was passed as an option to the 'subprocess.kill()' method (i.e., subprocess.kill('SIGTERM', {forceKillAfterTimeout: 1000})). In the updated version, you must instead use 'forceKillAfterDelay', passed as a top-level option to the 'execa()' function (i.e., execa('node', ['file.js'], {forceKillAfterDelay: 1000})). The 'subprocess.kill()' method no longer accepts this option.
